evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/f/e defines a skill count of 24 plus the full ordered lowercase skill-name array from attack/defence/strength through construction/hunter/summoning.

The class owns a parallel 24-row metadata table containing human-readable skill labels and exact skill-interface widget IDs (for example Attack/50023, Defence/50065, Construction/50215, Hunter/50225 and Summoning/50235).
The class owns the parallel boolean skill-enabled array consumed by Client when iterating skills; all current 0..24 slots are initialized true in exact v308.

Client sizes multiple skill-state arrays from rs/f/e.a, gates skill processing through rs/f/e.d and resolves skill UI metadata through rs/f/e.c; the live skill-level-change plugin path also reads rs/f/e.b to derive skill display names.
The class contains static skill metadata only and no player skill levels, XP mutation, combat formula or server rule logic, so SkillDefinitions is narrower and more accurate than SkillManager.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the central static skill metadata/definition catalog. No server-side skill rules are claimed.
